en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a small village set on a hillside with stone houses, a church with a bell tower, and a dramatic rocky outcrop in the foreground. Several people are visible on a path near the rock. The setting is rural and mountainous, with trees and hills in the background. The text at the top identifies the scene as being from Coudès to Saint-Nectaire, specifically Verrières and its 'Dick' (likely referring to a rock formation or notable site).
